name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.102.0 — the review fix-cap survives a cold restart — spec-review-driver counts this spec's uncleared `escalated:true` ledger rows as spent iterations, so deleting the sidecar no longer resets the loop (dispositions warns before workers are dispatched into a spent cap); design Step 6 gains the blocking AC ↔ design-landed reconcile (`design-ac-reconcile.js`: an AC naming a landed component must be tagged `[pre-green: design-landed]` or cited in Decisions before `designed:` stamps); exit 124 from the gate or a red-check run auto-records a `test-watchdog-trip` incident on the build row. 7.101.0 — build-time incidents count toward materiality (core § Incident Policy): `spec-build-driver --mark incident --class <id> [--exit <n>]` records an entry on the `stage:"build"` row (`incidents: [{ts, class, exit}]`, always present, `[]` when none) at any live step without moving the state; fleet-reader `--json` joins those entries into `escapes.byClass`/`recurrentUnguarded`/`registry` alongside escape rows and reports `escapes.incidents`, so a class that only ever costs build time can reach the third recurrence — previously it scored 0 forever (host spec 20260905/07 D16). `escapes.total` stays escape rows only. No red-check refusal is added: no class has reached three. 7.100.0 — red-check honours the `[env: VAR]` sanction ac-matrix.js already grants: a red-expected tests file observed green whose EVERY carried AC carries an `[env:]` tag downgrades `unsanctioned-green` to a warning naming each withheld variable, because a host whose testCommand withholds that variable makes the suite skip and `runLeg` (exit codes only) reads green from any shell — the redness is unobservable, not absent. `expected` is never flipped to green by the tag, so a genuinely-red env-gated file (variable provisioned, suite run) still matches its expected colour instead of reporting as `broken-pin`; a file mixing a gated AC with an ungated one still emits `unsanctioned-green`, narrowed to the ACs that actually owe a red with the gated ones named as sanctioned in the detail. The tag counts only when the test file MENTIONS the variable it claims to be gated on, closing the route where `[env: ANY_NAME]` on a vacuous pin would pass the build gate unchallenged (ac-matrix.js's own `[env:]` sanction reconciles SKIPPED tests, so a passing vacuous pin never reaches it). No new finding class, no config/contract change.
